newsitem.title: BOSNIA: British officer killed in Bosnia road accident.
newsitem.headline: British officer killed in Bosnia road accident.

text.p: A British military officer has been killed and three others injured in a road accident, a spokesman for the NATO-led peace force IFOR said on Tuesday.
The spokesman, Major William Syms, said the accident happened around 2.00 p.m. on Monday, on the road between the Bosnian towns of Mrkonjic Grad and Glamoc.
He said the accident happened close to the demarcation line which divides the Bosnian Serb republic and the Moslem-Croat federation.
According to Syms, one of the three injured soldiers was in a serious condition, while the other two were slightly hurt.
Syms said an investigation was under way into the cause of the accident. He declined to name the soldiers involved.
British troops make up one of the largest contingents in the 60,000-strong IFOR force serving in Bosnia to keep the rival Serb, Croat and Moslem factions from resuming the war that ended a year ago.
